title: rumohra quadripinnata
intro: Rumohra quadripinnata, commonly known as the Maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a plant traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rumohra quadripinnata include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
